I can do that — quick confirmation before I cancel:

1) Do you want to cancel the entire recurring series (all future Tuesdays) or just one upcoming occurrence?  
2) Is the event titled exactly "Design review" on your calendar?  
3) Are you the organizer of that meeting? (If you’re not the organizer I can remove/decline it from your calendar but I can’t cancel it for everyone.)  
4) If you are the organizer, should I notify all attendees when canceling?

Reply with your answers and I’ll proceed.
